text:
Maya Patel: Quick heads-up — FalconEdge asked to go live in Bahrain (me-south2) marketplace next month. They need GPU quota (8x A10X) + KMS onboarding. Can partnerships/ops triage? :eyes:
Liam O'Connor: tagging ops. Do we already have SKU mapping for me-south2?
Rajesh Kumar: Not yet — cloud provider gave a SKU but we need quota approval process. I can start the quota ticket.
Maya Patel: thanks Rajesh. Also FalconEdge needs marketplace listing to include a dedicated GPU SKU and private KMS options for enterprise customers.
Sophie Chen: legal checklist: we need export approval and MSA addendum for KMS. Send me the partner contact and draft listing copy.
Oliver Park: product note — we should offer two listing tiers: "shared" and "dedicated" GPU. Dedicated should call out predictable capacity. I'll draft the bullets.
Zara Ahmed: Partner engineering has the validation image. We ran smoke tests on a 4x A10X instance — perf looks stable. Will add the 8x run this week.
Liam O'Connor: Ops action items: 1) quota request to CSP, 2) reserve node pool in our dedicated capacity pool, 3) KMS entitlement setup with partner key wrap. I'll open tickets.
Rajesh Kumar: quota request draft (CLI snippet I pushed to the ticket):
```
gcloud compute project-info add-metadata --metadata "quota-request=GPUs:8:me-south2"
```
Liam O'Connor: @deploy-bot can you create a placeholder in inventory for bh-me-south2-dedicated-01 so we don't double-allocate?
deploy-bot: Created inventory item bh-me-south2-dedicated-01 (status: reserved) — ticket #INV-9842
Maya Patel: Sophie, I'll DM the partner contract and the listing copy. Oliver, once you have the tier bullets, I'll attach to the marketplace form.
Sophie Chen: got it. Also short question: does FalconEdge require HSM-backed KMS or will cloud KMS be fine? We need that for compliance flags.
Zara Ahmed: FalconEdge prefers customer-managed key (bring-your-own-key) for enterprise customers but cloud KMS is fine for standard customers.
Rajesh Kumar: timeline ask from partner: 3 weeks. CSP quota approvals usually take ~7 business days once submitted. KMS entitlements + legal haggling might add another week.
Oliver Park: I'll aim to have listing copy and tiers by EOD Friday.
Liam O'Connor: I'll open the quota ticket now and cc ops/partnerships. Ticket ref: CSP-Q-2137.
Maya Patel: great — summary next steps: Rajesh submits quota ticket (CSP-Q-2137), Liam reserves inventory (INV-9842), Oliver drafts listing, Sophie does legal review, Zara completes 8x smoke tests. Ping me on blockers. :thumbsup:
Zara Ahmed: noted — starting the 8x run tonight, will post perf log here.
Maya Patel: thanks team — will sync with FalconEdge on Friday for a go/no-go.
Liam O'Connor: FYI linking partner onboarding checklist: https://redwood.internal/docs/partner-onboarding/bahrain-checklist
Maya Patel: closing loop — I'll update the partner and set a calendar invite for the Friday sync.
